page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from hyper-threading. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a standard general-purpose option. It is suitable for workloads such as mid-range web serving, application servers, and general-purpose development environments that require stable CPU performance but do not demand local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration.
